eft_title: EPLAN Field Test Kit — Step-by-step Guide
eft_subtitle: Validate .ema/.emp macros on a real EPLAN P8 and record results in the accompanying checklist
eft_s1_p1: This kit is for verifying the EPLAN outputs (window macro library .ema and page macro .emp). The guide describes the drag-and-drop procedure step by step, and the Excel checklist is the result form for each device.
eft_s1_p2: Honest limitation: the graphical symbol (O17) cannot be generated outside EPLAN; in the macros each device is reproduced as an interruption point carrying the device tag and part number. Visual, definitive acceptance is only possible by dragging the macros into a real EPLAN project.
eft_s2_p1: EPLAN P8 2024 or newer (older versions may reject the macro structure).
eft_s2_p2: Access to the macro directory (Options > Settings > User > Directories > Macros) or any folder you can drag from.
eft_s2_p3: A parts database containing the part numbers in the checklist, or a test project using the same device tags.
eft_step1: Unzip the project bundle and copy these folders to the EPLAN machine:
eft_step2: Open EPLAN P8 2024 or newer and create a test project whose page structure matches your panel tags.
eft_step3: Insert the page macros (.emp) via Insert > Macro (Page) and match the existing page names against the expected-files table.
eft_step4: Drag the window macros (.ema) onto an empty page; the devices appear as interruption points with DT and part number.
eft_step5: For each checklist row, check the device tag (P20013) and part number (P20100) in EPLAN and compare them with the expected values.
eft_step6: Select the result of each row in the Result column from the dropdown (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N/A).
eft_step7: For every FAIL or BLOCKED row attach a screenshot and a short explanation in the Notes column.
eft_step8: Return the completed checklist together with the EPLAN version, project name and test date to the development team.
eft_checklist_note: Per-device details (tag, part number, page, description) are in EPLAN_FieldTest_Checklist.xlsx.
eft_s5_p1: Pass: all rows are PASS (or N/A with a recorded reason).
eft_s5_p2: Fail: any FAIL row or any row left pending; report the failed item with a screenshot.
eft_s5_p3: Blocked: only when the test environment prevents drag-and-drop or the parts database; record the reason.
eft_footer: LV-PanelAssist — EPLAN field test kit (phase 14) — generated together with the Excel checklist.
eft_cl_result_hint: One of PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or N/A
eft_readme_t: How to fill the EPLAN field-test checklist
eft_readme_p1: Each row is one device in one macro file. After dragging the macro into EPLAN, verify the device tag and part number.
eft_readme_p2: When every row is filled, validate the file with python -m lv_assist.eplan_field_test validate <file.xlsx>; exit code 0 means accepted.
eft_readme_p3: Limitation: the macros are interruption points with DT/part, not graphical symbols; record BLOCKED items with a reason.
